short: Noise-augmented self-supervised AVSR training (M03) was new in 2022 but rests on single runs; its 49.6% babble gain mixes data and model with pre-training; no variance (M12).
position: The paper [@shi2022robust] changes training (M03): self-supervised audio-visual pre-training with noise in pre-training and fine-tuning. None of the 143 AVSR ledger studies dated before it pre-trains self-supervised or adds noise in pre-training (Appendix), but M03 is standard because every result is one run on one test set and noise in pre-training adds only 1.5 and 1.1 WER points (Table 3). M12 is behind the best comparable work, which reported confidence intervals or repeated runs [@makino2019rnnt; @sterpu2020teach; @sterpu2020avtaris]. The 49.6% babble gain over [@xu2020discriminative] measures the whole recipe (unlabelled data, LARGE model, 30 h against 433 h of labels), not robustness from pre-training. At the same 30 h budget, later pseudo-labelling reaches 2.2% against 3.3% clean AVSR WER without noise augmentation [@haliassos2026usr2].
